newsitem.title: USA: Muni yields fall up to 10 basis points over week.
newsitem.headline: Muni yields fall up to 10 basis points over week.

text.p: Municipal bond yields fell up to 10 basis points in the week ended Thursday, Delphis Hanover Corp said on Friday.
The municipal rally was not as strong as in the Treasury market, where the long bond dropped 16 basis points over the same period and ended Thursday's session at 6.89 percent.
Thirty-year, Aaa-rated municipal yields fell five basis points to 5.65 percent, while thirty-year Baa yields fell 10 basis points to 6.35 percent.
In the intermediate sector, ten-year Aaa-rated muni yields were unchanged at five percent, and Baa-rated 10-years were also steady at 5.80 percent.
Average yields on one-year Aaa-rated municipal bonds were unchanged at 3.75 percent and Baa-rated one-years rose five basis points to 4.55 percent.
The Aaa municipal yield curve flattened five basis points, moving to 190 basis points. The spread between one-year and 30-year Baa's flattened 15 to 180 basis points.
The credit spread between Aaa-rated and Baa-rated one-years widened five basis point to 80 basis points, and the 30-year spread narrowed the same amount to 70 basis points.
